name: google-health-mcp
description: Reads Google Health API data - heart rate, steps, exercises and their GPS routes, sleep, weight, height, SpO2, HRV, ECG, irregular-rhythm notifications and account settings - into a local SQLite cache for fast offline queries and trend analysis. OAuth 2.0 with automatic token refresh, incremental sync, a cache-only offline mode, and a doctor command that diagnoses a setup without spending quota.
